subscription.title: Doctor subscription
subscription.description: The subscription provides access to the professional profile, services, clinics, availability and RomDoc appointment tools.
subscription.smsNote: Messaging and SMS service costs are separate and are included in the doctor subscription.

sms.title: Appointment SMS service
sms.description: RomDoc can provide SMS notifications as a separate operational appointment service.
rules: SMS messages are operational notifications, not medical communication.
SMS confirmations may be sent when an appointment becomes confirmed.
The platform may send a reminder approximately 24 hours before the appointment.
The SMS service is billed separately from the doctor subscription.
Unpaid costs may accumulate until the outstanding balance is paid.
The SMS balance may be paid through RomDoc and Stripe when that flow is available.
Messages should not include diagnoses, symptoms, medical notes or results.

manual.title: Fields used by doctors and staff

workflow.title: From confirmation to completion
items: The patient receives email confirmation and, when enabled, SMS confirmation.
The patient may receive a reminder before the appointment.
The patient arrives at the clinic.
The doctor performs the consultation and necessary investigations.
The doctor or authorized staff uploads relevant documents when needed.
The appointment is closed using the completion action.

security.title: Safe use rules
rules: Use only your own RomDoc account and do not share your password.
Check the patient and appointment before uploading a document.
Access only information needed for your professional activity.
Do not export or share documents without an appropriate legal basis and authorization.
Sign out after using a shared device.
